privacyPolicy.title: AOSER Policies
privacyPolicy.intro: These policies take effect immediately upon your registration as a member or user of AOSER.

section1.title: Security & Privacy Policy
section1.description: AOSER places the highest priority on the security of user data and is committed to strictly protecting personal information in accordance with international standards.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection and Use
items: Only essential data will be collected: name, phone number, email, photos, location, and identity verification documents
Data will be used solely for service-related purposes: identity verification, bookings, coordination, and invoicing

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
items: Data encryption is applied to all transactions
Information is stored on secure servers with backup systems
Strict internal access controls are enforced
Two-factor authentication (2FA) is required for critical accounts

userRights.title: Your Rights
items: Request access, correction, or account deletion at any time
File complaints regarding personal data breaches
Contact us at: support@aoser.app

requirements.title: Requirements:
items: Must register with accurate, verifiable information
Illegal use such as human trafficking, gambling, or sexual services is strictly prohibited
Fake orders or fraud to exploit service providers is prohibited

violations.title: Violations:
items: AOSER reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts without prior notice
Repeated violations may result in referral to legal authorities

requirements.title: Requirements:
items: Must verify identity with documents (Passport, ID card, license, rental contract)
Must provide accurate service/property details (real photos/videos, pricing, hours)
Illegal or immoral services are strictly prohibited

violations.title: Violations:
items: More than 3 poor-quality service reports may lead to temporary suspension
Fraud (bait-and-switch or fake service) will result in permanent account termination

paymentMethods.title: Payment Methods
items: QR Code
Mobile Banking
Credit/Debit Cards
Supported E-Wallets (domestic)

payoutConditions.title: Provider Payout Conditions
items: Payment is released after service completion and customer confirmation
Funds are transferred within 1–2 business days to registered bank account

platformFees.title: Platform Fees
platformFees.note: * Fees are automatically deducted before disbursing payments to providers

ratingSystem.title: Rating System
items: Customers can rate services from 1 to 5 stars after completion
Reviews must be respectful and constructive
Ratings influence the provider's visibility on the platform

topRated.title: Top Rated Benefits
topRated.description: Providers with an average rating of 3.5 stars and above will be listed as "Top Rated" with benefits:
items: Homepage visibility
Priority recommendations
Access to promotional campaigns

qualityMonitoring.title: Quality Monitoring
items: 3+ complaints for poor service result in temporary suspension
Random monthly checks for accuracy, cleanliness, and provider behavior

customerCancellations.title: Customer Cancellations
customerCancellations.note: * Refunds are processed within 3–7 business days via original payment method

providerCancellations.title: Provider Cancellations
items: Customer receives 100% refund if provider cancels without valid reason
Provider's credibility score will be reduced and may face temporary suspension

serviceNotAsAdvertised.title: Service Not as Advertised
items: Complaints must be submitted within 48 hours
Full refunds for misrepresentation, partial refunds for valid damages

contactSupport.title: Contact Support (24/7)
items: In-app chat
Email: support@aoser.app
Telephone (Laos): xx-xxxx-xxxx

responseTimes.title: Response Times
items: General inquiries: within 24 hours
Urgent issues (fraud): within 1–12 hours
Complaint resolution: within 5 business days

platformExpansion.title: Platform Expansion
items: Aiming to expand from Laos to ASEAN within 2–5 years
Building local partnerships to support freelancers, hospitality, and rental services
Prioritizing local employment and in-country development teams

transparencyCommitment.title: Transparency Commitment
items: Quarterly performance reports will be published
System updates every 3 months with security and UX/UI testing
User feedback used to inform future improvements

prohibitedUses.title: Prohibited Uses
items: Illegal or immoral activities
Fake accounts or misleading content
Posting inappropriate material

liabilityLimitation.title: Liability Limitation
items: AOSER acts solely as a platform to connect clients with providers
Not liable for actions or errors by users unless directly caused by platform failure
If payment is made outside the AOSER platform, AOSER will not be liable for any disputes or damages

policyAmendments.title: Policy Amendments
items: AOSER reserves the right to amend policies without prior notice
Users should regularly review terms to ensure compliance with the latest version

privacyPolicy.footer:
Last updated: July 2025
By using AOSER, you agree to these policies and terms of service.
